g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the build fills it exactly (hold-down frame + vent riser pin the box)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Bull-block wire drawer per the AQS-MFG-010 tool row (Table 2.1, rev C metering split): nameplate 1.1 kW, energy basis 250 MPa x strain 3.0 / 0.55 (DIETER1988) + no-load 15 % x 1 h (A-M-177)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: The DRAW accepted idiom (commit e1e7d94b) scaled to the node box: bench bed x 100..700, die stand -X with the carbide die set, bull-block drum OD 300 at +X z 600, fume hood over the die zone
Graph revision AD - ga_front: A-MACH: die-zone/drum guard rail + hold-down frame + 8 slab anchors
